META_NOTES.pair_note: a pair is the client's lua.read of its mirror level, mirror state, moodle level, view class and received count, at once the server's lua.read of the last push signature, the push count and the record's energy state (one tick each), then the world age; the server's held level is the signature's energy digit (K.view.signatureEnergy), the client's shown level its mirror's body_energyLevel when a whole number, else its view's class (K.view.mirrorEnergy)
META_NOTES.lag_note: lag_est is the client's first new-level read's wall minus the server's first new-level read's; its bracket runs from the last old-level reads on each side; walls are the driver's clock
META_NOTES.snack_note: the snack is TKX.Mixed400, not a smaller one: a 217 kcal snack empties barely faster than the fast spends and dips es by about 0.0006 (the docstring's arithmetic)
META_NOTES.spawn_note: the foods are spawned by RCON additem and confirmed by the server's item.get id (ruling T2-11)
META_NOTES.eat_note: a networked eat ends in real time, 232 x 20 ms a loop, whatever the clock (#3766); Mixed650 eats in two
META_NOTES.frame_note: no frame window is graded in this session (no tick.ring), so no drop_windows apply

FOOD.item.get after the spawn: an id for TKX.Mixed400 and TKX.Mixed650, none before
FOOD.falsifier: an id missing on a live bus

LEVEL_RISE.server: first level-1 pair es >= ENERGY_AT[1] - ES_TOL; last level-0 pair es < ENERGY_AT[1] + ES_TOL
LEVEL_RISE.unmeasured: no change in RISE, or its bracket over 5.0 s or across phases

LAG_RISE.client: its first level-1 read at most 65.0 s of wall after the server's
LAG_RISE.expected: about 16 game minutes at the slow spacing (C-28)
LAG_RISE.falsifier: lag_est over the bound, the client changing first, or to a level the server never held
LAG_RISE.unmeasured: no server change, a bracket (server or client) over 5.0 s or across phases, or the client's cap ended before the bound

HOLD.established: only the pairs after the first pair reading 1 on both sides
HOLD.falsifier: a level other than 1 on either side in the band
HOLD.unmeasured: no pair established the hold, or fewer such pairs

LEVEL_FALL.server: first level-0 pair es < AT1 - BAND + ES_TOL; last level-1 pair es >= AT1 - BAND - ES_TOL
LEVEL_FALL.unmeasured: no change in FALL, or its bracket over 5.0 s or across phases

LAG_FALL.client: its first level-0 read at most 65.0 s of wall after the server's

SLOW.falsifier: a measured read off (a null read is unmeasured)

Z.players: answers a list (the server alive at the end)

deviations: The snack is TKX.Mixed400, not a 'small' snack (the docstring's arithmetic).
HOLD is 90 s of pairs, not the sheet's 3 min, for the budget; FALL's slow part adds in-band pairs to HOLD.
The profile adds TKX_StudyFoods for the snack and the meal.
Pre-run edit after the Opus review of f099c44a: FALL skips its meal when an eat stopped; HOLD, LEVEL_FALL and LAG_FALL carry stop_reason and grade void when it is set.

Pre-run edit: LEVEL_* and LAG_* read unmeasured unless the change's bracket is bounded (at most BRACKET_MAX_S of wall, the same phase; the server side for both, the client side for LAG_*); FAST_STOP_GAP 0.006 (was 0.004).
Pre-run edit: HOLD counts only the pairs after the first pair reading level 1 on both sides; unmeasured when none did.
Pre-run edit: the guide names FALL's possible cut by the wall budget.
